data_protocol.split: Per-student chronological 60/20/20 with time_done ascending and original source-row tie-breaker.
data_protocol.future_leakage: Only train/history labels fit NCDM and rate baselines. Validation selects all candidates and the comparator before the final test rows are opened.
data_protocol.final_test_policy: One final evaluation after the fixed configuration and validation selections; an ignored ledger rejects a repeated candidate evaluation.

baselines.exercise: Train/history Exercise historical correct rate with global fallback for an Exercise absent from train/history.
baselines.topic: Train/history Topic historical correct rate with global fallback for a Topic absent from train/history.

ncdm.reference_component: InsCD NCDM / Default extractor / NCD_IF equations through the archived split-safe adapter.
ncdm.comparison_boundary: C40_TOPIC and C_FINE_EXERCISE use this same architecture and optimizer schedule. Only Q-matrix and ModelConcept cardinality differ.
ncdm.onehot_q_execution: Algebraically equivalent first-layer selection for the sole nonzero Q input; it preserves NCDM parameters and interaction equations while avoiding known-zero dense multiplications.

C40_TOPIC.concept_definition: Eligible Exercise maps to exactly one frozen business Topic.

C_FINE_EXERCISE.concept_definition: Eligible Exercise maps to exactly one sequential ModelConcept; Q is identity-style.

bootstrap.method: Paired nonparametric bootstrap over final-test interactions; report-only and never used for model selection.

doa.definition: Exercise-conditioned pairwise future-response agreement: later correct versus later incorrect students on the same Exercise are ordered by the relevant Q-selected mastery fitted from train/history; ties score one half.
